# DESIGNBYTWM

> An automotive customization house in Houston, Texas. Not a shop. Every discipline is executed in house by one team, from first consultation through final delivery.

DESIGNBYTWM is located at 18235 Ammi Trail, Houston, TX 77060. Phone (832) 402-9174. Open Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00.

The house works on luxury, exotic, performance and daily driven vehicles, from a single package to a complete build. Because every discipline stays under one roof, finishes are planned together rather than handed between vendors.

## Disciplines

- [Blackout Packages](https://designbytwm.com/services/blackout-packages): chrome delete, badging, grille, trim and accent work in gloss, satin or matte
- [Paint Protection Film (PPF)](https://designbytwm.com/services/paint-protection-film): self-healing film in partial, track and full-body coverage
- [Vehicle Wraps](https://designbytwm.com/services/vehicle-wraps): full colour change, partial wraps, roof and hood treatments in premium cast vinyl
- [Wheels & Fitment](https://designbytwm.com/services/wheels-and-fitment): forged and flow-formed wheels, offset and stance planning, TPMS and road force balancing
- [Interior Transformation](https://designbytwm.com/services/interior-transformation): full leather and technical textile retrims, bespoke stitching, suede headliners
- [Suspension](https://designbytwm.com/services/suspension): lift and leveling kits, lowering springs, coilovers and air suspension
- [Paint & Body](https://designbytwm.com/services/paint-and-body): full and partial repaints, custom colour, panel repair and refinishing
- [Lighting](https://designbytwm.com/services/lighting): headlight and taillight work, ambient interior and accent lighting
- [Audio](https://designbytwm.com/services/audio): speaker, amplifier, subwoofer and DSP systems with custom enclosures
- [Truck Accessories](https://designbytwm.com/services/truck-accessories): bumpers, steps, racks, bed covers and off-road equipment

## Service area

Houston and the surrounding area, including The Woodlands, Katy, Sugar Land, Cypress, Spring, Tomball, Humble, Kingwood, Pearland, Friendswood, League City, Missouri City, Pasadena, Baytown, Conroe, Richmond, Fulshear, Bellaire, Memorial, Magnolia and Hockley.
